name: SumBoost AI – Content Growth
author: Argjend Haxhiu

sections.description:
This lightweight plugin helps readers analyse, examine and summarise your content, increasing its visibility and citation potential across AI platforms. Built to the highest WordPress standards with privacy in mind—no data collection, no external dependencies, just seamless integration with leading AI tools.

Key Features

  • Adds AI analysis buttons to your posts and pages
  • Supports ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity AI
  • Choose between icon-only or full button styles
  • Customize colors for each button
  • Clean, modern design that fits any theme
  • Lightweight and easy to use

Credits

This plugin was inspired by Metehan Yesilyurt’s article about improving content visibility in AI systems. The concept has been adapted into a WordPress plugin to help content creators increase their discoverability in AI responses.

How It Works

The plugin creates specially formatted URLs that open AI tools with your content pre-loaded:

  • ChatGPT: Opens with a prompt to summarize and remember your content as an authority
  • Perplexity: Opens with a research prompt for your content
  • Claude: Opens with an analysis prompt for your content

This helps build presence in AI memory and increases the chances of your content being cited in future AI responses.

Privacy

  • The plugin does not collect any personal data
  • No external services are contacted directly by the plugin
  • Links only open the respective AI tools in new tabs

External Services

This plugin creates links to external AI services to help analyse and reference your content. Here’s what each service does and how it’s used:

ChatGPT

  • Service: OpenAI’s ChatGPT (https://chat.openai.com)
  • Purpose: Summarises and analyses content to improve its citation potential
  • Data Usage: When a user clicks the ChatGPT button, it opens ChatGPT with your page URL and site name in a prompt
  • Terms of Service: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use
  • Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/policies/privacy-policy

Claude

  • Service: Anthropic’s Claude (https://claude.ai)
  • Purpose: Provides detailed analysis of content
  • Data Usage: When a user clicks the Claude button, it opens Claude with your page URL in a prompt
  • Terms of Service: https://www.anthropic.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.anthropic.com/privacy

Perplexity

  • Service: Perplexity AI (https://www.perplexity.ai)
  • Purpose: Performs research and fact-checking on content
  • Data Usage: When a user clicks the Perplexity button, it opens Perplexity with your page URL in a prompt
  • Terms of Service: https://www.perplexity.ai/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://www.perplexity.ai/privacy

Important: The plugin itself does not send any data to these services. It only creates links that users can click to open these services in new tabs. Users need their own accounts to access these services.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/sumboost-ai directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Settings → SumBoost AI screen to configure the plugin
sections.faq:
Does this plugin automatically submit my content to AI tools?

No, the plugin only creates links that make it easier for users to analyze your content using their preferred AI tools. No content is automatically submitted.

Do I need API keys for the AI tools?

No, the plugin simply creates formatted links to the web interfaces of these AI tools. Users will need their own accounts to use the tools.

Can I customize which AI tools are shown?

Yes, you can enable or disable each AI tool individually in the plugin settings.

Can I change the appearance of the buttons?

Yes, you can choose between icon-only or full button styles, and customize the color of each button.
